title: A table a live feed keeps current
summary: One fetch, then every change after it folded into the list the page already holds — one entry written per frame, and no copy of the list between them.

bench.note: AUTHORED, not measured — nothing here runs until the compiler does. LINES OF CODE IS THE EXCEPTION: counted from the two arms in this download, code lines only, both arms complete — markup, client and fold.

rows.metric: Index entries written per frame, with `set` instead of `patch`

tests.note: `bun test examples/patch-a-list`. The fold is asserted on the index rather than on the rendered table, a rebuild and a patch producing the same markup.

rows.name: a frame replaces one entry and leaves the index identity standing
a tombstone drops its entry and nothing else
a patch wakes readers once, and once per frame rather than per entry
a refetch replaces every entry a patch had written
